summary: All Phase 2 criteria pass: TypeScript clean, build passes, services/auth/firestore correct, Nominatim replaces Google Maps, RHF+Zod on all forms, two-step registration correct, Firestore rules cover all 4 collections, AvailabilityToggle accessible, both FEAT JSONs completed; 3 minor findings (dual h1 on RegisterPage step transition, mapAuthError drops err.message for unknown codes in RegisterPage, Nominatim User-Agent lacks contact email) are non-blocking.

findings.label: Dual h1 on RegisterPage
findings.detail: Step 1 and Step 2 each render an <h1> in-place. Assistive technologies won't announce the step transition. Change step 2's heading to <h2> or add an aria-live region.

findings.label: mapAuthError drops err.message for unknown codes
findings.detail: RegisterPage's mapAuthError(code) returns a hardcoded string for unrecognised codes, losing the actual Firebase error message. LoginPage's version accepts a fallback — align RegisterPage to match.

findings.label: Nominatim User-Agent lacks contact email
findings.detail: Nominatim policy requires a contact address in User-Agent or a From header. 'Djema/1.0' alone may get rate-limited. Append a contact email.
